svg.title: Swan Determination / Purification / Redemption / Truth Gate
svg.desc: A single sluice passage runs directly from the courtyard stone wall to the central cube. One labelled purification gate runs lengthwise from the wall to the cube, turned ninety degrees from a cross-passage gate. Prayer forms the radial plane. Small Christian and other faith symbols accompany it. A recognizable white swan with a curved neck, wing, black eye and orange-and-black bill rises above it. Prayer streams converge at the cube; figures move through the one passage. An authored spiritual diagram, not a judgment of actual people.

g.text: PRAYERS FOR ISLAM · EARTH · UNIVERSE · ALL BEINGS
each circuit passes through the radial gate
One cross at the cube’s top edge · other faith symbols alongside
“Thy will be done” · peace · forgiveness · protection
Author’s spiritual composition · one passage and one gate · animated circulating figures
